title: AW28 Women's Pink Standard
summary: Pink as a neutral: blush to dusty rose blazers, skirt suits and romantic voile dresses with lace.
research_period: AW28/29 colour previews (October 2026), AW27 fairs (September 2026), SS28 previews

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. AW28 fabric fairs take place in September 2027 and the shows in early 2028. This report projects from the first AW28/29 colour forecasts, the AW27 fabric fairs, SS28 previews and long-term market and regulatory drivers. Forecut will update it as evidence arrives.

sections.heading: The story
sections.body: Pink becomes a neutral base, no longer limited to womenswear, suggested for blazers, skirt suits and voile dresses with ruffles or lace <sup>[1]</sup>.

sections.heading: Colours
sections.body: Blush, dusty rose, rosehip with brown.

sources.title: Spotted on the catwalk: Future Snoops' colour trends for AW28/29
